label: rem:brane-tower-terminology
title: Terminology: brane vs Yekutieli
html:
The mathematics here traces the iterated jet prolongation A_{n+1} = J^1(A_n). One assigns the term brane to each localized layer A_n, representing a geometric boundary enclosing level-n internal degrees of freedom.

One calls the lifting condition [yekutieli2010] that governs extensions from n to n+1 the quantum lifting condition, and reserves the qualifier Yekutieli for the nonabelian multiplicative integration [yekutieli2015] over the tower. These results control structural assembly rather than the Kähler-differential jet object itself. One therefore writes simply (recursive) brane tower for the sequence.
